JUMBO ECO BOX – An Eco-Friendly Gift Set | BG1250

The JUMBO ECO BOX – An Eco-Friendly Gift Set (BG1250) is a premium sustainable gifting solution designed for businesses that value thoughtful presentation and environmentally responsible gifting. This eco-friendly corporate gift set combines practical office accessories made from natural, recycled, and biodegradable materials. Each item reflects a commitment to green gifting, making it a perfect choice for employee welcome kits, festive gifting, corporate events, and brand promotions.

With sustainability becoming a priority for modern workplaces, eco-friendly gifts have emerged as one of the most searched corporate gifting categories. The JUMBO ECO BOX fits perfectly into this high-demand segment by offering a curated set of reusable and nature-friendly stationery essentials. Built with cork, bamboo, MDF, and plantable materials, the kit is completely aligned with environmentally conscious corporate culture.

Why Choose the JUMBO ECO BOX for Corporate Gifting?

The world is shifting toward greener, smarter, and more sustainable corporate choices. This eco-friendly gift set is not only visually appealing but also thoughtfully created to reduce carbon footprint. With items like a cork diary, magnetic cork planter, bamboo pen, and plantable calendar, this gift box inspires users to adopt sustainability in their daily routine.

The JUMBO ECO BOX – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set | BG1250 is ideal for companies searching for high-value eco-friendly corporate gifts that truly reflect their brand’s commitment to sustainability. Whether you are planning bulk corporate gifting, employee joining kits, festive hampers, or promotional giveaways, this recycled and reusable gift box enhances brand value while delivering utility and style.

What’s Inside the JUMBO ECO BOX?

  • Magnetic Cork Planter – A stylish eco planter that can be placed on desks or magnetic surfaces to promote greenery at workspaces.
  • Cork Diary A5 (Classic) – An elegantly designed A5 diary with a cork cover, offering smooth writing and overall sustainability.
  • Bamboo Pen – A durable and eco-conscious pen made from natural bamboo, ideal for everyday use.
  • Plantable Calendar (MDF) – A unique plantable calendar crafted using seed paper with an MDF frame, encouraging users to grow plants.
  • 4 Cork Coasters with Holder – Functional and attractive cork coasters with a matching holder, perfect for office desks and homes.
  • Cork Sticky Notes – Reusable sticky note boards made using natural cork material for quick reminders or pin-ups.
  • Cork Mouse Pad – A durable cork mouse pad that provides excellent desk comfort and is fully eco-friendly.
  • Packed in an Eco Box (10″ x 11″ x 3.5″) – A sturdy, recyclable eco box that completes the premium sustainable gift set.

Features & Benefits

  • Premium eco-friendly gift set designed for corporate gifting.
  • Includes functional office accessories made from cork, bamboo, plantable paper, and MDF.
  • Reusable, biodegradable, and sustainable materials.
  • Perfect for eco-conscious companies and green gifting initiatives.
  • Suitable for employee onboarding kits, festive gifts, business events, and CSR-driven gifts.
  • Attractive eco box packaging ideal for branding and presentation.

Perfect for Corporate Gifting & Sustainable Promotions

The growing demand for eco-friendly gifts has made the JUMBO ECO BOX a popular choice among HR teams, corporate procurement departments, event organizers, and brand managers. When companies choose sustainable gift sets, they showcase responsibility, innovation, and alignment with global environmental goals.

This gift set offers high perceived value, making it suitable for premium gifting. Every element inside the box is designed to promote daily utility while reinforcing the importance of sustainability.

SEO Summary

If you are searching for eco-friendly corporate gifts, sustainable gift sets, recycled gift boxes, or premium eco stationery kits, the JUMBO ECO BOX – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set | BG1250 is the perfect addition to your corporate gifting portfolio. It blends utility, aesthetics, and sustainability into one complete package, making it a standout choice for thoughtful green gifting.
